title: BPS spectra of $\operatorname{Tr}[Ψ^p]$ matrix models for odd $p$
summary: We study the BPS cohomology and Hamiltonian of a model built from an $N\times N$ matrix $Ψ$ of complex fermions, with supercharge $Q_p={\rm Tr}(Ψ^p)$ for odd $p\ge3$. Numerical calculations give the BPS multiplicity at every fermion number for $(p,N)=(5,3),(5,4),(5,5),(7,4)$, and through fermion number six at $(7,5)$. In $Z_{BPS}^{(p,N)}(x)=\sum_Rh_Rx^R$, $x$ records fermion number and $h_R$ counts BPS states in sector $R$.
